84: #[derive(Default)]
85: pub(super) struct State {
86:     pub(super) safety: Arc<Safety>,
87:     current: Option<Transfer>,
88:     seen_uncertain_epoch: u64,
89:     unresolved: BTreeMap<Uuid, Message>,
90:     acknowledge_review: Option<(u64, Vec<Uuid>)>,
91:     pending_resume: Option<Uuid>,
92: }
93: 
94: struct Transfer {
95:     id: Uuid,
96:     choice: Choice,
97:     stage: Stage,
98:     summary: Message,
99:     feedback: Message,
100:     picker: Option<Uuid>,
101: }
102: 
103: enum Choice {
104:     Upload,
105:     Download { offer: Uuid, name: String },
106: }
107: 
108: enum Stage {
109:     Upload,
110:     Download { offer: Uuid, name: String },
111:     Review { review: Uuid },
112:     Running,
113:     Ended,
114: }

162:     pub(super) fn zmodem_event(&mut self, event: ZmodemUiEvent, cx: &mut Context<Self>) {
163:         let endpoint = self.transport_target.as_deref().unwrap_or("");
164:         match event {
165:             ZmodemUiEvent::UploadRequested { id } => {
166:                 self.zmodem.current = Some(Transfer {
167:                     id,
168:                     choice: Choice::Upload,
169:                     stage: Stage::Upload,
170:                     summary: Message::new(
171:                         format!(
172:                             "当前 SSH 目标：{endpoint}\n远端接收程序请求 Zmodem 上传。选择本地文件后，先审核完整文件清单；选择本身不会发送文件。"
173:                         ),
174:                         format!(
175:                             "Current SSH target: {endpoint}\nThe remote receiver requests a Zmodem upload. Choose local files, then review the complete list. Selecting files does not send them."
176:                         ),
177:                     ),
178:                     feedback: Message::empty(),
179:                     picker: None,
180:                 });
181:             }
182:             ZmodemUiEvent::DownloadOffered {
183:                 id,
184:                 offer,
185:                 name,
186:                 size,
187:             } => {
188:                 self.zmodem.current = Some(Transfer {
189:                     id,
190:                     choice: Choice::Download {
191:                         offer,
192:                         name: name.clone(),
193:                     },
194:                     stage: Stage::Download {
195:                         offer,
196:                         name: name.clone(),
197:                     },
198:                     summary: Message::new(
199:                         format!(
200:                             "当前 SSH 目标：{endpoint}\n远端文件：{name}\n声明字节数：{size}\n\n选择新的本地文件名，然后审核并确认。当前尚未接受文件内容；已有文件不会被覆盖。后续文件需要分别审核。"
201:                         ),
202:                         format!(
203:                             "Current SSH target: {endpoint}\nRemote file: {name}\nDeclared bytes: {size}\n\nChoose a new local filename, then review and confirm. No file content has been accepted. Existing files are preserved. Each subsequent file requires its own review."
204:                         ),
205:                     ),
206:                     feedback: Message::empty(),
207:                     picker: None,
208:                 });
209:             }

278:             ZmodemUiEvent::FileSaved {
279:                 id,
280:                 path,
281:                 bytes,
282:                 sha256,
283:             } => {
284:                 if let Some(current) = self
285:                     .zmodem
286:                     .current
287:                     .as_mut()
288:                     .filter(|current| current.id == id)
289:                 {
290:                     current.feedback = Message::new(
291:                         format!(
292:                             "已验证保存：{}\n{bytes} 字节\nSHA-256: {sha256}",
293:                             path.display()
294:                         ),
295:                         format!(
296:                             "Verified saved file: {}\n{bytes} bytes\nSHA-256: {sha256}",
297:                             path.display()
298:                         ),
299:                     );
300:                 }
301:             }
302:             ZmodemUiEvent::Finished { id } => {
303:                 self.end_zmodem(id, Message::new(
304:                     "Zmodem 协议已完成。上传结果仍需在远端检查；下载以已验证保存的回执为准。",
305:                     "Zmodem protocol completed. Inspect uploaded files remotely; downloads are confirmed by their verified save receipts.",
306:                 ), false);

630:                 }
631:                 Stage::Running => actions,
632:                 Stage::Ended => actions.child(
633:                     Button::new("zmodem-dismiss")
634:                         .small()
635:                         .ghost()
636:                         .label(t(cx, "收起回执", "Hide receipt"))
637:                         .on_click(cx.listener(move |view, _, _, cx| {
638:                             if view.zmodem.current.as_ref().is_some_and(|current| {
639:                                 current.id == id && matches!(current.stage, Stage::Ended)
640:                             }) {
641:                                 view.zmodem.current = None;
642:                             }
643:                             cx.notify();
644:                         })),
645:                 ),
646:             };
647:             if !matches!(current.stage, Stage::Ended) {
648:                 actions = actions.child(
649:                     Button::new("zmodem-cancel")
650:                         .small()
651:                         .ghost()
652:                         .label(t(cx, "取消 Zmodem", "Cancel Zmodem"))
653:                         .on_click(cx.listener(move |view, _, _, cx| {
654:                             view.zmodem_control(ZmodemControl::Cancel { transfer: id }, cx)
655:                         })),
656:                 );
657:             }
658:         }
659:         for summary in self.zmodem.unresolved.values() {
660:             body = body.child(
661:                 div()
662:                     .text_color(rgb(visual.warning))
663:                     .whitespace_normal()
664:                     .child(summary.render(cx)),
665:             );
666:         }
667:         if !self.zmodem.unresolved.is_empty() {
668:             let reviewing = self.zmodem.acknowledge_review.is_some();
669:             if reviewing {
670:                 body = body.child(t(
671:                     cx,
672:                     "请检查以上每个原始目标和临时文件。再次确认仅允许关闭窗口，不代表传输成功、回滚、清理或解除文件隔离。",
673:                     "Inspect every original destination and staging file above. Confirming again permits window closing only; it does not establish success, rollback, cleanup or removal of file quarantine.",
674:                 ));
675:             }
676:             actions = actions.child(
677:                 Button::new("zmodem-acknowledge-unknown")
678:                     .small()
679:                     .ghost()
680:                     .label(if reviewing {
681:                         t(
682:                             cx,
683:                             "已核对，确认未知结果",
684:                             "Inspected: acknowledge unknown outcomes",
685:                         )
686:                     } else {
687:                         t(cx, "核对未知结果", "Review unknown outcomes")
688:                     })
689:                     .disabled(self.zmodem_input_blocked())
690:                     .on_click(cx.listener(|view, _, _, cx| view.acknowledge_zmodem_outcomes(cx))),
691:             );
692:         }
693:         Some(
694:             div()
695:                 .id("zmodem-transfer")
696:                 .test_support()
697:                 .occlude()
698:                 .capture_any_mouse_down(
699:                     cx.listener(|view, _, _, cx| view.publish_input_selection(cx)),
700:                 )
701:                 .track_focus(&self.zmodem_focus)
702:                 .absolute()
703:                 .bottom_2()
704:                 .left_2()
705:                 .right_2()
706:                 .p_3()
707:                 .rounded_md()
708:                 .border_1()
709:                 .border_color(rgb(visual.border))
710:                 .bg(rgb(visual.surface))
711:                 .text_color(rgb(visual.text))
712:                 .flex()
713:                 .flex_col()
714:                 .gap_2()
715:                 .child(div().font_semibold().text_sm().child("Zmodem"))
716:                 .child(body)
717:                 .child(actions)
718:                 .into_any_element(),
